background: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group is Japan's largest bank and one of the largest in the world, the holding company of MUFG Bank and Mitsubishi UFJ Trust, with a large stake in Morgan Stanley and banking subsidiaries in the US and Southeast Asia.
synthesis: Rated A on average across all three, the weakest of them at A- and all three on a stable outlook; there has been no move since a one-notch downgrade by one of the three on 8 Apr 2020. Capital is the only measure held and it is on the weak side of Asian banks, with CET1 of 12.9% below the median, and it has fallen 1.0 points since 30 Jun 2025 (figures to 30 Jun 2026). No leverage or liquidity ratios are held, so the reading rests on that single figure beside the ratings. Earnings have been strong, but the thinning capital buffer noted in the item of 1 Sep 2026 is the point to watch: it is the trend, not the level, that has changed.
